description: This file defines the WatchConnectivityReceiver class, along with related data structures, to handle communication between an iOS app and a WatchOS extension using WatchConnectivity. It manages session activation, message sending, and receiving notifications and user info.

classes.name: WatchConnectivityReceiver
classes.description: A class managing the watch connectivity session, sending messages, and handling incoming notifications.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Activates the WCSession if supported and sets self as delegate.

methods.name: ensureActivated
methods.description: Ensures the session is activated, waiting asynchronously if necessary.

methods.name: sendReply
methods.description: Sends a reply message to the watch, attempting immediate message transfer and falling back to transferUserInfo if needed.

methods.name: normalizeObject
methods.description: Normalizes different object representations to a dictionary string-to-any mapping.

methods.name: parseActions
methods.description: Parses a list of raw action data into WatchPromptAction instances.

methods.name: parseNotificationPayload
methods.description: Parses incoming payload data into a WatchNotifyMessage if it matches expected format.
